neighbours.label: the 'never been better / more X than ever' construction: an all-time extreme stated by comparison with every earlier time
fire: With fuel prices climbing, saving energy at home is more important than ever.
There has never been a better time to learn a second language.
Honest local journalism has never been more necessary.
As the floods spread, it is more urgent than ever to send help.
Business has never been better for the small bakery on Main Street.
The demand for trained nurses has never been greater.
In an age of rumours, checking the facts matters more than ever.
It has never been easier to start a company from your kitchen table.
quiet: With fuel prices climbing, saving energy at home is quite important.
There was a good time to learn a second language when I was young.
Honest local journalism has always been necessary.
As the floods spread, it is very urgent to send help.
My cousin has never been to the small bakery on Main Street.
The demand for trained nurses has been great this year.
Has anyone ever checked the facts in that old story?
It was never easy to start a company from your kitchen table.

notes: Probe: 'never been more important' 0.60, 'more urgent than ever' 0.33; 'never been to Paris' 0.01, 'Have you ever seen' 0.05.
